h1: Dairy Farm Sheds in Pakistan: Steel Cattle Housing Built for Heat and Airflow
quickAnswer: A good dairy shed gives shade, lets hot air leave and keeps the floor dry. Steel Mind has built dairy sheds of 39,330, 22,000 and 21,686 square feet for Dravton Dairy and Latifia Dairy.
alt: Steel dairy farm shed with open sides and ridge ventilation in Punjab.

faq.q: How many animals can a shed hold?
faq.a: It depends on the area per animal and the layout. The engineer will plan the width and length from your herd size.
Yes. Bolted frames allow extra bays at the end.

blocks.text: Heat is the main problem for dairy animals in Pakistan. A good shed gives shade, lets hot air leave and keeps the floor dry. Steel Mind designs the roof, the sidewalls and the ridge to support these needs.

A high roof and an open ridge let hot air rise and leave. Open or louvered sides allow cross-flow of air, and louvers protect from rain. Insulated roof sheets reduce the heat that reaches the animals. Floor slope and gutters keep manure and rain water away from the animals. The frame spacing should match the feed alleys, stalls and the milking area.

Steel Mind built a PEB dairy shed of 39,330 square feet for Dravton Dairy at Chunian, 17 feet high, 115 feet wide and 342 feet long. It built a PEB dairy shed of 22,000 square feet for Latifia Dairy at Kasur, 17 feet high, 110 feet wide and 200 feet long. It also built a PEB milking parlour shed, a dairy feed storage shed and a rapid exit structure for Dravton Dairy. Taki Dairy is also a client. Many dairy clients return later to add feed storage, which is easy with bolted PEB frames.
A farm often grows over time. Steel Mind can build the first shed now and add bays later, as your herd grows.
